summary: We developed an interactive, space-themed educational website called Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, designed to make space learning exciting and accessible for students aged 7–12. Our website includes features such as Astronaut Career Path, Advanced Space Science, Human Spaceflight, Planet Explorer, Rocket Launch Simulator, Space Survival Training, Mission Control Dashboard and Lunar Outpost Manager. It also includes interactive activities and simulations like the Moon Landing Simulator to help students understand basic space mission concepts such as fuel management, spacecraft landing, astronaut survival and lunar resource management. Our project addresses the challenge by transforming traditional space education into an engaging, hands-on learning experience rather than simply providing theoretical information. It encourages curiosity, creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills while introducing students to STEM concepts and future opportunities in space science. The main goal is to inspire young learners to explore the universe and develop an early interest in space exploration.
details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational website designed to make space exploration exciting and easy to understand for students aged 7–18. It provides information about astronaut careers, advanced space science, human spaceflight, planets, rocket launches and space survival. It also includes interactive activities and simulations, such as a Moon Landing Simulator and Lunar Outpost Manager, to help students learn through exploration and decision-making.

Our project aims to make space education more engaging than traditional learning methods while encouraging curiosity, creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. We developed the website using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Its creative approach combines educational content, animations and interactive simulations in one platform. The project is designed to inspire young learners to explore space science and develop an interest in STEM careers.
